purpose: Repair the proven double-terminal-completion lifecycle for notify-owned background jobs.

predecessor.evidence: 01a-clineMessages.LIVE_RAW.json (SHA-256 fe1b6bc7791a50483a3faed1790f149e98bfc48c8407b4266ea803719034ae36) — operator-supplied persisted dump proves submit_and_exit count = 2 for jobId cmd_mugvhy92x7rm527e.

live_root_cause: Two semantic terminal completion authorities are claimed for ONE notify-owned background job. The originating turn synchronously waits the job to terminal state via `command_status(J, waitMs=30000)` and calls `submit_and_exit`. The wake-driven turn also runs `submit_and_exit`. submit_and_exit count for J = 2.

test_bnca_red_01.primary_observation: When Path A enqueues a wake via fire-and-forget transport (mirror of SdkController.ts:738 `void active.sdkHost.send(...).catch(...)`) and Path B fires resolveObligation synchronously, the discard seam returns `not_found` because the wake has not yet landed. The wake survives and proceeds to start a second autonomous turn.

test_bnca_red_02.primary_observation: Pins the live defect at the C10 completion-commit seam (`sdk-session-event-coordinator.ts:691-733`). With H1 advisory + TQCB barrier the originating turn's completion is held when marker J is alive; framework-enforced suppression is required when marker is gone AND wake was delivered.

selected_authority_model.name: H1 advisory + framework-level C10 barrier
selected_authority_model.description: Two complementary mechanisms close the live defect at the framework seam: (a) H1 advisory in command_status returns `notification: "pending"` for notify-owned active jobs with waitMs>0, suppressing Path B resolveObligation. (b) Framework-level barrier at the C10 completion-commit seam consults `BackgroundNotifyCoordinator.hasActiveNotify(jobId)` (HOLD when marker alive) and `BackgroundNotifyCoordinator.wasWakeDelivered(jobId)` (SUPPRESS when wake delivered to pendingPrompts — wake-driven turn owns completion). The barrier is enforced at the `setTurnPhase("completed", ...)` call, NOT at the tool surface — the model CANNOT bypass it.
implementation_seams: apps/vscode/src/sdk/background-notify-coordinator.ts (wakeAuthoritySettledJobIds + wakeDeliveredJobIds trackers, wasWakeDelivered + isWakeAuthoritySettled probes, ~80 lines added)
apps/vscode/src/sdk/sdk-session-event-coordinator.ts (per-job consult in C10 barrier admission + reevaluation, ~60 lines added)
apps/vscode/src/sdk/SdkController.ts (wiring of new options, ~12 lines added)
selected_authority_model.rationale: The H1 advisory is a comment-only convention the model MAY ignore — not load-bearing. The framework-level C10 barrier enforces the invariant at the lifecycle seam (`setTurnPhase("completed", ...)`) where the originating turn's `submit_and_exit` is committed. The barrier consults the per-job wake-delivered probe and SUPPRESSES the originating completion when the wake was delivered (the wake-driven turn owns terminal completion). Conservation: R4 (non-blocking read) + R5 (non-notify) + R6 (multi-job) all preserved.

halt_history.raised_observation: The H1 advisory fix is comment-only — the model MAY still invoke `submit_and_exit` claiming the notify-owned job's terminal result. The post-repair graph still permits two lifecycle completion calls. The GREEN does not test the load-bearing invariant: `semantic_terminal_completion_count(J) == 1`. The conclusion 'wake is sole terminal-completion authority post-repair' exceeds the implementation.
halt_history.required_repair: Reopen the authority design at a framework-level lifecycle seam. Make completion ownership framework-enforced — at the seam where `submit_and_exit` commits task completion. The key invariant: notify-owned J with outstanding wake authority ⇒ originating run cannot commit a terminal task completion for J.
halt_history.closed_observation: BNCA-FRAMEWORK-01a (production wire: real SdkSessionEventCoordinator + real BackgroundNotifyCoordinator + real command_status tool) drives the full causal chain: notify-owned J → originating turn's submit_and_exit → framework SUPPRESSES the `setTurnPhase("completed", ...)` because the wake was delivered. The deferredCompletionBarrier is set; completionCommitCount === 0. BNCA-FRAMEWORK-ABLATION-01-RED proves the live defect re-emerges when the framework fix is removed (completionCommitCount === 1). The model CANNOT bypass the framework barrier.
